title: Interphase hand-off: meadow-snapshot-pacing spec handed to mitosis as one MSP of four ordered Steps
context: Interphase (bug pathway, autonomous) finished docs/specs/meadow-snapshot-pacing.md with 14 criteria (10.1-10.14), 4 Steps (pacer-snapshot-room, single-image-render-steps, stage-snapshot-room, frame-free-first-build) in one MSP, 14 assumptions and 2 open questions. Two spec-reviewer rounds: 15 issues, then 4 (runAsync waits for Isolate.run geometry, every pump of the two-batches-behind stage test on frames, new timing for the pacer error-callback test, one-sided device bounds with the Android settle at the unchanged median plus 400 ms from the 1,719 vs 1,386 ms same-session data); all fixed, check_record, check_spec, check_items pass, tree guard clean, status handed-off. Criteria 10.12-10.14 are unproven by the builder (Windows PC, Android emulator, macOS VM) and are measured by the main conversation after the build. Overrides recorded as top risks: decisions file meadow-opening-recolour-stutter lines 16 (fixed cap of 4; builds on frames without a GPU-time limit), 20 (one after-batch marker; builds sized by room and half-frame UI time) and 22 (15-frame bound now 21 single-image steps).
options: Hand off now and build with mitosis from ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-snapshot-pacing/ on base mitosis/meadow-snapshot-pacing-base (origin/main 6b095878)
Run a third spec-reviewer round before handing off
Split the four Steps into separate MSPs and pull requests
option_reasons: The four re-review findings were narrow test-timing and bound fixes, each checked against the code (pacer cost is after minus before; timers inside frame callbacks reschedule onto frames when the test schedules one) and every interphase check passes
A third round would recheck only text already verified against the code; review of the built diff follows in stage 3 anyway
The Steps share meadow_stage.dart, the harness and the stage test and build in order, so separate MSPs would serialise into the same chain while splitting one behaviour change across pull requests
outcome: Handed off. Next: copy the items file to the run home, run run.zsh --plan-only, then build. Top risks for the final report: unproven 10.12-10.14, the decisions-file overrides of lines 16, 20 and 22, builds on frames with no GPU-time limit (sharpen up to about 0.4 s later on 60 Hz slow GPUs), and the Android settle allowed up to 400 ms behind the unchanged build.
